hack.root_cause: Flash loan + missing slippage control in rebalancing function → liquidity drain
hack.description: Jimbo's Protocol attempted to create a semi-stablecoin via a floor-price rebalancing mechanism (described by observers as "OHM flashbacks"). The v2 had just launched — it was the team's second attempt after a buggy v1 fell apart on launch days earlier. v2 added leverage complexity.
